4. ALLOCATION WINDOW PRECONDITION: Unit selection, Add, T&C, Pay and post-payment cases require an ACTIVE campaign (Admin creates STATIC/DYNAMIC campaign, start >= 3 min ahead, exactly one active campaign on UAT, at least one Active tower in Config). Outside an active window the page shows the waiting state or 'Allocation window is closed for now.' — so these cases are inherently window-dependent and carry [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] rather than being dropped.

5. MUTATION-AUTHORISATION WARNING: Selecting a unit places a real 20-minute Redis HOLD; ticking T&C + Pay sends pay_now_initiated/proceed_to_pay and opens the live Easebuzz/Razorpay gateway; completing payment BOOKS a real unit and sets WINNER permanently. WINNER status is irreversible. Do NOT select/Add/Pay/Book on a UAT fixture without explicit user authorisation and a disposable registration. Capture-only steps (viewing the grid, opening Floor & Unit Plan / Cost Sheet / Payment Schedule, reading the right panel) are safe.

6. ALLOCATION GLOSSARY: STATIC = all eligible buyers see all available units at once, first to pay wins. DYNAMIC = system auto-assigns a unit per band/round, timed window (FSD-CORRECTION: band-based, NOT round-robin — see DOC_DRIFT-002). PHYSICAL_EVENT = SM books on a walk-in customer's behalf (SM portal, out of scope here). HOLD = 20-minute Redis lock from when payment is initiated. WINNER = the only status that means the unit is booked (WAITLIST/PREALLOCATED/ALLOCATED are pre-payment). Webhook is the source of truth for BOOKED, not the browser.

7. STATUS BADGES: Home Dashboard Status column = Available (green) / Waitlisted (dark) / Booked (green check) / Refunded (red). Allotment sidebar registration pills = 'Book Now' (green, unit available to select) / 'Booked' (green check) / 'Waitlisted' (black).

8. SILENT-BY-DESIGN: Capture-only actions (open Floor & Unit Plan, Cost Sheet, Payment Schedule, Cancel/deselect) do not dispatch SMS/WhatsApp/email. unit_sold and reallocation_notification are in-app WebSocket pushes, not external notifications. Verify the backend/WebSocket side-effect before flagging a missing toast as a defect.

9. REAL-TIME (WebSocket): the screen auto-updates without refresh. Received: connection_established, user_details_response, towers_response, tower_units_response, unit_details_response, tower_refresh, unit_sold, reallocation_notification. Sent: user_details, towers, tower_units, unit_details, pay_now_initiated, proceed_to_pay. JWT is passed in the WebSocket URL (/ws/:token).
